items.quote: Ecwid uses OAuth 2.0 to provide secure access to the store data for public apps.
items.why: Quote says OAuth 2.0 for public apps only. Nothing on bearer tokens, custom-app tokens, or no expiry.

items.quote: If you customize your own store, however, you can skip OAuth and easily get an access token for your store.
items.why: Quote confirms custom stores skip OAuth. Doesn't cover bearer_token, token types, or non-expiry.

items.quote: After signing up with Ecwid and getting a custom app, you already have two tokens:
items.why: Quote says signup yields two tokens. Consistent with no paid gate, but never mentions a paid plan.

items.quote: Ecwid creates one custom app for any user who visits the app dashboard in Ecwid admin for the first time.
items.why: Quote says custom app created on first dashboard visit. Matches the detail, not the paid_plan gate.

items.quote: We accept up to 600 requests per minute per token.
items.why: Quote states the 600 req/min per token limit only. Nothing on REST v3, endpoints, or breadth.

items.quote: Read store products, orders, customers, categories and coupons; adjust inventory and update orders.
items.why: Quote lists connector capabilities, not MCP. Nothing on existence, vendor status, or the URL.
